title: School Programs (1999 - Present)
subtitle: J2SE, Java2D, ISAM DB, BerkeleyDB, JNI, JNLP, Flash, AWS, SimpleDB, PHP
text: I designed, architected and developed or led teams to develop a total of 81 (K-6) school programs in Java, HTML5 and Flash. Programs such as Math, Science, Reading, etc... These programs were designed by many teachers and each one is expected to take a child months to complete.
